extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, created using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad (Faculty of Engineering Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt)
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The older arabic-small-nougat model occasionally generates irrelevant content, including nonexistent URLs or images; Both arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat exhibit repetition issues, particularly in lengthy sequences; The computational resources required for training arabic-large-nougat are significant; Performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested; Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors aim to contribute to the broader field of document parsing and promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Extracting structured text in Markdown format from Arabic book pages; General text extraction tasks; Extracting text from lengthy or complex documents; Downstream NLP tasks and further Arabic OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create a synthetic dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
